theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ R : IMRep U n) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = R₁.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + R₂.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ) • R.orient y) x = R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x + R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x
